text:
I did not love you;
I do not love you;
I know well that I do not,
that I do not,
that it is the hour,
the light,
the summer afternoon.

I know it,
but I love you.
Now I love you,
today,
this afternoon I love you,
as I loved you on other afternoons,
desperately,
with blind love,
with anger,
with the saddest knowledge,
beyond desire,
or illusion,
or waiting,
and waiting all the same,
waiting for you,
seeing
you come,
at last,
you arrive,
just passing through.

translation.title: No te amaba
